scope.en: One operation mishap, "Confidence Wavers": pools, options and all follow-ups.

texts.zh:
一队位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于[from.GetName]行动甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[operation.leader.GetHeSheCap]同样也承认可能只是他们的洞察力过分敏锐罢了。

基于以上怀疑，以及各种猜测对于[from.GetName]行动可能的威胁，间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]请求指示接下来该如何进行。
texts.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing them to our attention, but even without them knowing any details: these operatives seem unusually well-informed about Operation [from.GetName], and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active and better-informed agents, [operation.leader.GetName] suspects the operatives are being fed information from an outside source. [operation.leader.GetHeSheCap] also concede[operation.leader.GetSXX] that they may simply be highly perceptive individuals.

Given these doubts - and the threats posed to Operation [from.GetName] by each scenario - Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] requests a directive on how to proceed.

texts.zh:
一组位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工在执行分配给它们的任务时进度开始滞后，并做出一些能被解析为怀疑的行动。我们通常直接命令间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]来解决此事，但这些特工表现得它们似乎能察觉到行动[from.GetName]中所埋藏的阴谋，也许还有整个间谍网也在它们的知情范围内。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们更为活跃的代理个体保持隔离，我们怀疑有外部势力在向它们灌输信息。然而，如果可能的话，它们与自主代理个体的趋同或许能够赋予它们自己一种我们今后有机会将其利用到的洞察力。

基于以上怀疑，以及各种猜测对于[from.GetName]行动可能的威胁，间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]请求指示接下来该如何进行。
texts.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] has begun lagging in their assigned tasks, displaying behavior which could be interpreted as doubt. We would typically handle such matters directly through Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName], but this group acts as though it can perceive the wider machinations of Operation [from.GetName], and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active agents, we suspect they are being fed information from an outside source. It is, however, also possible that their proximity to independent agents may simply have endowed these operatives with the kind of insight we may one day find useful.

Given these doubts - and the threats posed to Operation [from.GetName] by each scenario - Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] requests a directive on how to proceed.

label.en: The risks are too great; cut them loose.

label.zh: 那就让我们看看这些“洞察力”会带来什么吧。
label.en: Let us see where these 'insights' may lead.

Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] revealed only a glimpse of the bigger picture to them, but it was sufficient to disrupt our supply lines. Our ability to subvert [target_country.GetAdj] Encryption is reduced for a time.

summary.text:
# 信任危机 / Confidence Wavers

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nemesis_operations_events_1.txt, common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt, common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt · DLC：Nemesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

行动失手随机事件：间谍行动某一阶段的检定失败时，on_roll_failed 调用 standard_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed（common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt:2331-2386）：每次失败有 1/40 的几率（39:1）从该行动类型指定的事件池中抽一件，且同一行动 90 天内只触发一次。事件池按双方帝国类型（普通/集体意识）选择（:2390-2821）。
Mishap: when an operation stage roll fails, on_roll_failed calls standard_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed, which has a 1-in-40 chance to draw one event from the pool named by the operation type (at most one per 90 days per operation); pools are chosen by empire kinds.
本事件进入的事件池：
- 几乎所有行动池都含有此事件（EF:2487、2542、2563、2633、2665、2686、2813），权重1。 present in almost every pool.
Pools containing it:
present in almost every pool.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

5055：辅助特工对任务信心动摇。a 割舍他们（有条件）/ b 听听这些“洞见”→ 5056“打破砂锅问到底”（真相使辅助特工格外卖力，奖励）或 5057“惊慌失措的特工”（惊恐破坏补给线，惩罚）。
5055: auxiliaries lose confidence; cut them loose, or listen -> 5056 (they redouble effort) or 5057 (they panic).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 5056 与 5057 互斥。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 目标可能是国家或恒星基地（文本两种）。

- 已核对 Checked：5055-5057。
